item.title: AJA closes out the year with a busy December
item.description: The AJA team is closing out an action-packed 2025 by attending three events this month. We’ll kick things off in Turkey during Aviteng Technology Days from December 3-5. There, attendees can explore live demonstrations of AJA gear and connect directly with product experts. Up next, on December 11, is Band Pro Open House in Burbank, California, where AJA will gather with other industry pros conversations about the future of cinema, broadcast, and production. item.title: AJA releases FS4 v3.1.2 and FS-HDR v4.3.2
item.description: AJA today launched free FS4 v3.1.2 and FS-HDR v4.3.2 updates for its popular frame synchronizers. Download the releases today from AJA’s support page for network security enhancements.

item.title: BRIDGE LIVE v1.18 update boosts UHD channel performance
item.description: AJA has released BRIDGE LIVE v1.18, a free update for its turnkey solution for live encoding, decoding, transcoding, streaming, and more. The latest version enhances codec efficiency to support higher UltraHD channel counts and includes key improvements and bug fixes. To upgrade, users must have v1.16.10 already installed. Download the update today from the AJA Support Page.

item.title: QPAC elevates live streams with AJA gear
item.description: Performing arts venues worldwide are investing in stronger live production pipelines, and the Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC) is a standout example. After years of successfully live streaming performances for broader access and reduced broadcast costs, the team is now leveling up with a 4K HDR infrastructure overhaul powered by AJA technology. item.title: Ki Pro Ultra 12G v2.8 firmware releases
item.description: AJA today released a new update for its Ki Pro Ultra 12G multi-channel 4K/UltraHD/HD recorder and player. The latest release includes important fixes and improvements, and users are encouraged to upgrade for optimal performance. Download free Ki Pro Ultra 12G v2.8 firmware now from the AJA Support Page.

item.title: Ring in the new year with AJA at events across the globe
item.description: Start the year off by visiting AJA at key industry events this month. Visit us at Hamburg Open, January 14-15 in Germany, to see live demos highlighting colour workflows, IP video, and more, and attend our on-site speaking session. The AJA team will also be out in full force at the Texas Film Gear Winter Showcase on January 15, and later in the month at the SVG Silicon Valley Video Summit on January 27. Explore these events and others on AJA’s events page.

item.title: Explore AJA’s streaming solutions for live & on-demand video
item.description: Video streaming is ubiquitous, from social media and corporate communications to live sports, concerts, and even healthcare. The ways organizations deliver content continue to evolve, with more complex, multi-camera workflows and remote production setups becoming the norm. AJA’s new Streaming Solutions page provides a high-level overview of the technologies, protocols, formats, and codecs that make these experiences possible. item.title: MeyerPro helps keep Microsoft Ignite signals live with AJA
item.description: When AV Solutions Provider MeyerPro took on AV for the Microsoft Ignite conference in San Francisco, its team got to work quickly to architect and deploy a robust video infrastructure. Designed to support on-site and remote production needs for the event, the pipeline leveraged fiber conversion, frame sync, and recording technology from AJA. The setup helped ensure smooth production and live delivery of keynotes, technical sessions, and other event highlights to in-venue LED walls and audiences
